nodes.description: approve or reject the current revision for adoption, under authority; only once it is within the floor and its checks pass. Held by a person by default; a deployment may grant it by policy for a generation built only from trusted fragments
nodes.name: protocol.approve

nodes.description: run canon check on the current revision and record its report
nodes.name: protocol.check

nodes.description: run canon diff of the current revision against the organization floor, as a runner outside evaluation does, and record its report
nodes.name: protocol.diff

nodes.description: the record that a holder of protocol.adopt decided on one revision of the generated protocol; its result is approved or rejected
nodes.name: adoption_approval

nodes.description: canon check on one revision of the generated protocol; its result is passed or failed
nodes.name: check_report

nodes.description: canon diff of one revision of the generated protocol against the organization floor; its result is within_floor when the revision is within the floor, any other result when it is not
nodes.name: diff_report

nodes.description: a holder of protocol.adopt approved the current revision
nodes.name: adoption.approved

nodes.description: canon check passed on the current revision
nodes.name: checks.pass

nodes.description: the current revision is within the organization floor, by a canon diff report
nodes.name: floor.respected

nodes.description: the current revision of the generated protocol is adopted: within the floor, its checks passed, and approved under protocol.adopt
nodes.name: adopted

protocol.description: Adopt one revision of a generated protocol: it is adopted only with a canon diff report within the organization floor, a passing canon check report and an approval under the capability protocol.adopt, each about the revision under adoption. Evaluation reads the two reports as evidence and runs neither tool.
